data.one_liner: Highlight text, text fields, and text spans with customizable rounded corners.
data.what_it_does: Provides specialized widgets that paint rounded background highlights directly behind text using custom line metrics. Supports multiline text, selectable text, and text input fields.
use_when: You need to highlight text with rounded background corners in Flutter.
You want rounded background highlights inside text fields or rich text spans.
avoid_when: You just need standard rectangular background colors available natively in TextStyle.
strengths: Supports multiline text and text fields with automatic highlight tracking.
Provides custom control over inner and outer corner radii.
weaknesses: Corner radius values are restricted between 0.0 and 20.0.
data.minimal_example:
RoundedBackgroundText(
  'A cool text to be highlighted',
  style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
  backgroundColor: Colors.white,
)
